mapper.select: SELECT MODULE,TOTAL_COUNT,FCST_RETURN_COUNT,ACT_RETURN_COUNT,DELAY_RECOVER_COUNT ,ROUND(FCST_RETURN_COUNT*100/TOTAL_COUNT,1)FCST_RETURN_RATIO ,ROUND(ACT_RETURN_COUNT*100/TOTAL_COUNT,1)ACT_RETURN_RATIO FROM( SELECT NVL(MODULE,'TTL')MODULE ,COUNT(1)TOTAL_COUNT ,SUM(FCST_RETURN_FLAG)FCST_RETURN_COUNT ,SUM(ACT_RETURN_FLAG)ACT_RETURN_COUNT ,SUM(DELAY_RECOVER_FLAG)DELAY_RECOVER_COUNT FROM( SELECT MODULE ,MFG_MODULE ,EQP_ID ,ACT_RETURN_TIME ,FCST_RETURN_TIME ,CASE WHEN FCST_RETURN_TIME <= TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MI') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FCST_RETURN_FLAG ,CASE WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ACT_RETURN_FLAG ,CASE WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NULL AND FCST_RETURN_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MI') THEN 1 WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ACT_RETURN_TIME > FCST_RETURN_TIME THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DELAY_RECOVER_FLAG FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD )GROUP BY ROLLUP(MODULE) )

SELECT MFG_MODULE,PRIORITY,TOTAL_COUNT,FCST_RETURN_COUNT,ACT_RETURN_COUNT,DELAY_RECOVER_COUNT ,ROUND(FCST_RETURN_COUNT*100/TOTAL_COUNT,1)FCST_RETURN_RATIO ,ROUND(ACT_RETURN_COUNT*100/TOTAL_COUNT,1)ACT_RETURN_RATIO FROM( SELECT NVL(MFG_MODULE,'TTL')MFG_MODULE,NVL(PRIORITY,'TTL')PRIORITY ,COUNT(1)TOTAL_COUNT ,SUM(FCST_RETURN_FLAG)FCST_RETURN_COUNT ,SUM(ACT_RETURN_FLAG)ACT_RETURN_COUNT ,SUM(DELAY_RECOVER_FLAG)DELAY_RECOVER_COUNT FROM( SELECT MODULE ,MFG_MODULE ,EQP_ID ,ACT_RETURN_TIME ,FCST_RETURN_TIME ,PRIORITY ,CASE WHEN FCST_RETURN_TIME <= TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MI') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FCST_RETURN_FLAG ,CASE WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ACT_RETURN_FLAG ,CASE WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NULL AND FCST_RETURN_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MI') THEN 1 WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ACT_RETURN_TIME > FCST_RETURN_TIME THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DELAY_RECOVER_FLAG FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD )GROUP BY ROLLUP(MFG_MODULE),ROLLUP(PRIORITY) )ORDER BY DECODE(MFG_MODULE,'PH',1,'ET',2,'TF',3,'DF',4,'WET',5,'CMP',6,'WCS',7,'Metro',8,'NPW',9,10),PRIORITY

SELECT EQP_G,PRIORITY,TOTAL_COUNT,FCST_RETURN_COUNT,ACT_RETURN_COUNT,DELAY_RECOVER_COUNT ,ROUND(FCST_RETURN_COUNT*100/TOTAL_COUNT,1)FCST_RETURN_RATIO ,ROUND(ACT_RETURN_COUNT*100/TOTAL_COUNT,1)ACT_RETURN_RATIO FROM( SELECT NVL(EQP_G,'TTL')EQP_G,NVL(PRIORITY,'TTL')PRIORITY ,COUNT(1)TOTAL_COUNT ,SUM(FCST_RETURN_FLAG)FCST_RETURN_COUNT ,SUM(ACT_RETURN_FLAG)ACT_RETURN_COUNT ,SUM(DELAY_RECOVER_FLAG)DELAY_RECOVER_COUNT FROM( SELECT MODULE ,MFG_MODULE ,PRIORITY ,EQP_G ,EQP_ID ,ACT_RETURN_TIME ,FCST_RETURN_TIME ,CASE WHEN FCST_RETURN_TIME <= TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MI') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FCST_RETURN_FLAG ,CASE WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ACT_RETURN_FLAG ,CASE WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NULL AND FCST_RETURN_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MI') THEN 1 WHEN ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ACT_RETURN_TIME > FCST_RETURN_TIME THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DELAY_RECOVER_FLAG FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD WHERE MFG_MODULE = #{module} )GROUP BY ROLLUP(EQP_G),ROLLUP(PRIORITY) )ORDER BY EQP_G,PRIORITY
SELECT FUNCTION_NAME,KEY1,KEY2,KEY3,ROUND(KEY2*100/KEY3,1)||'%' RATE FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = '2026suixiuRecover'

SELECT * FROM( SELECT MFG_MODULE,EQP_G,EQP_ID,"TYPE",TO_CHAR(FCST_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')FCST_TIME,VALUE FROM( SELECT EQP_G,MFG_MODULE,EQP_ID,'Plan' TYPE ,TRUNC(FCST_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')FCST_TIME,1 VALUE FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD UNION ALL SELECT EQP_G,MFG_MODULE,EQP_ID,'ACT' TYPE ,TRUNC(ACT_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')ACT_TIME ,CASE WHEN TRUNC(FCST_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')>=TRUNC(ACT_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END VALUE FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD WHERE ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT MFG_MODULE,EQP_G, 'TTL'EQP_ID,"TYPE",FCST_TIME,SUM(VALUE)VALUE FROM( SELECT MFG_MODULE,EQP_G,EQP_ID,"TYPE",TO_CHAR(FCST_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')FCST_TIME,VALUE FROM( SELECT EQP_G,MFG_MODULE,EQP_ID,'Plan' TYPE ,TRUNC(FCST_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')FCST_TIME,1 VALUE FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD UNION ALL SELECT EQP_G,MFG_MODULE,EQP_ID,'ACT' TYPE ,TRUNC(ACT_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')ACT_TIME ,CASE WHEN TRUNC(FCST_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')>=TRUNC(ACT_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END VALUE FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD WHERE ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL ))GROUP BY MFG_MODULE,EQP_G,"TYPE",FCST_TIME UNION ALL SELECT MFG_MODULE,'TTL'EQP_G, 'TTL'EQP_ID,"TYPE",FCST_TIME,SUM(VALUE)VALUE FROM( SELECT MFG_MODULE,EQP_G,EQP_ID,"TYPE",TO_CHAR(FCST_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')FCST_TIME,VALUE FROM( SELECT EQP_G,MFG_MODULE,EQP_ID,'Plan' TYPE ,TRUNC(FCST_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')FCST_TIME,1 VALUE FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD UNION ALL SELECT EQP_G,MFG_MODULE,EQP_ID,'ACT' TYPE ,TRUNC(ACT_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')ACT_TIME ,CASE WHEN TRUNC(FCST_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24')>=TRUNC(ACT_RETURN_TIME ,'HH24') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END VALUE FROM A1MFG.EQP_RECOVER_MONITOR_UPLOAD WHERE ACT_RETURN_TIME IS NOT NULL )) GROUP BY MFG_MODULE,"TYPE",FCST_TIME )ORDER BY MFG_MODULE, DECODE(EQP_G,'TTL',1,2),EQP_G ,DECODE(EQP_ID,'TTL',1,2),EQP_ID,DECODE(TYPE,'Plan',1,2),TYPE

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('2026-04-15 20:30','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')+ROWNUM/24-1/24 ,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')SHIFT_DATE_LINE ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('2026-04-15 20:30','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')+ROWNUM/24-1/24 ,'MM-DD HH24:MI') SHIFT_DATE_LABEL FROM DUAL CONNECT BY ROWNUM <= 109
